text:
nora-cs: Quick note: customer 'Meridian' reported onboarding stalls when their CI runs preflight heavy on multiple regions. Getting 429s intermittently across eu and us regions. They need temporary help before tomorrow's cutover.
nora-cs: User logs attached: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/preflight
Host: api.redwood.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
X-Redwood-Region: us-east-1
Response: 429 rate_limit
```
sam-eng: Could be cross-region DNS egress; if they have CDN egress or cloud-run jobs that resolve to different edge clusters, tenant-level bucket enforcement will kick in. Ask for traceroute/IPs and tenant id.
mateo-cs: Tenant= t-meridian-7. IPs: 34.83.12.45, 34.86.7.191, 35.204.4.10.
infra-bot: observed spike for tenant t-meridian-7 2026-03-23T01:21:44Z preflight concurrent=16 token-refreshes clustered.
dev-rel: Recommend immediate steps: 1) pin region during init, 2) stagger token refresh across instances, 3) reduce preflight concurrency during CI warmups to <6.
onboard-engineer: Example RN snippet: 
```js
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  region: 'us-east-1',
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 },
  auth: { jitterMs: 200 }
});
```
sam-eng: Ops options: temporary cap increase, enable header fallback, or route IPs to nearest pool. Need ops request via ticket.
nora-cs: Customer OK with temporary bump; filing ticket now.
infra-bot: INC-9490 created: request cap bump for t-meridian-7 for 12 hours.
mateo-cs: Noted. We'll monitor.
dev-rel: Please advise to upgrade to sdk v0.9.3 which has jittered token refresh fix and lowered default preflight concurrency.
nora-cs: Thanks all, Ill coordinate cutover once ops confirms.
